title.en: Timber clad storage under a staircase

alt.tr: Ahşap dış merdivenin altını kapatan yatay tahta kaplama ve sürgülü, metal kollu depo kapağı
alt.en: Horizontal timber cladding closing in the space under an outdoor staircase, with a bolted door and handle

caption.tr: Merdivenin altı yatay tahtalarla kapatılıp depoya çevrilmiş. Kapak sürgü ve metal kolla açılıyor.
caption.en: The space under the stairs is closed in with horizontal boards to make storage, opened by a door with a bolt and handle.
